attacker_monitors_mempool.meaning: attacker observes pending transactions in the public mempool before execution

price_validation_absent.meaning: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange performs no price validation against TWAP or historical baselines

immediate_execution_no_delay.meaning: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange uses block.timestamp as deadline so the transaction executes immediately with no delay mechanism

fair_rate_execution.meaning: the liquidity addition executes at a fair rate not manipulable by surrounding pool-price changes, so the protocol receives liquidity value matching the assets it provided

attacker_profit_captured.meaning: the value extracted by surrounding the liquidity addition is captured as profit by the MEV bot

assumptions: The attacker is an unprivileged MEV bot operating in the public mempool, not an authorized protocol actor.
The protocol's liquidity addition is the sandwiched transaction whose surrounding price changes are attacker-controlled.
No concrete amounts or rate deviation are reported; the fair-rate and profit relations are qualitative.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric amounts, percentages, or rate deviation for the value extracted, so the profit magnitude cannot be bound numerically.
Report does not establish a prior pool state or historical baseline value before the attack, so a fair-rate reference quantity cannot be derived.

limitations: Fair-rate execution and attacker profit are represented as qualitative Booleans because the report supplies no numeric rate or extraction amount.
The relation requires both fair-rate execution and absence of attacker profit; the violation is fair-rate failure with profit capture.
Other impacts (unfavorable rate, reduced liquidity value, steady drain) are not formalized in this plan.
